export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for KALPATARU PROJECTS INTERNATIONAL LIMITED (101 PART III G I D C ESTATE SECTOR 28) reports "Total Shipments 31736 Records detected", "Trading Partners 73", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; row seen: "2026-02-28 | KALPATARU PROJECTS INTERNATIONAL LIMITED | KALPATARU PROJECTS INTERNATIONAL LT | SM - HARSIDDH CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT GST NO-24AIIPT7106Q1ZN- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Djibouti, ETHIOPIA | 96039000 | 1123866". Second record, same B/L 1123866, HS 90261090, destination Djibouti/Ethiopia. Top ports listed: Djibouti 670, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 612, Male 352, MIHAN ICD INKPK6 287. Counter check: page claims 31,736 shipments; only 5 shipment rows were visible on the free view (rows actually seen = 5), so the 31,736 figure is the site's counter, not a count I verified. Separate entity page for KALPATARU POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED shows 1 record: "2024-02-12 | KALPATARU PROJECTS INTERNATIONAL LIMITED | KALPATARU POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED | GALVANISED TRANSMISSIONLINE TOWERS AND PARTS THEREOF IN CKD CONDITION 733315.29 | THAR DRY PORT ICDAHMEDABAD GUJARAT ICD, India | ABU DHABI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 73082011 | 7455579" (counter 1, rows seen 1).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs/B-L records with B/L numbers, HS codes and destinations (Djibouti/Ethiopia, UAE, Maldives, Cameroon, Mongolia counterparties) exist for both the KPI entity and the Kalpataru Power Transmission entity. Declared HS 847180 (ADP/computer units) does not match the observed cargo: records show transmission line towers (73082011), machinery parts (84849000, 84811000, 90261090, 96039000) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual exported goods (power transmission towers/EPC equipment), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report India/export split) could not be retrieved: zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, kalpatarupower.com refused connection, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) — so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found, and no revenue figure is asserted (null). No CIN/PAN invented; PAN field left empty as supplied.
